gloss: sense of stagnation; feeling of being stuck

definitions.gloss: sense of stagnation; feeling of being stuck; oppressive atmosphere
definitions.explanation: A feeling that progress is blocked or that the situation is stifling and there is no way forward. Used for both personal feelings and broader social or economic conditions.

examples.japanese: {閉塞感|へいそくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a sense of stagnation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉塞感|へいそくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}っている→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: A sense of stagnation pervades society as a whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{閉塞感|へいそくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打破|だは}→打破：12808_daha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: New policies are needed to break through the sense of stagnation caused by the prolonged recession.

notes:
{閉塞感|へいそくかん} describes a feeling that progress is blocked and there is no way forward. A compound of ⟦{閉塞|へいそく}→閉塞：14561_heisoku⟧ (blockage, obstruction) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sense).

- {閉塞感|へいそくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel stagnation
- {閉塞感|へいそくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}う→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧: stagnation pervades
- {閉塞感|へいそくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打破|だは}→打破：12808_daha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to break through stagnation
- {閉塞感|へいそくかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be enveloped in stagnation

USAGE:
Frequently used in news commentary and essays about economic or social conditions. Can also describe personal feelings of being stuck in life or career. Tends toward formal or literary register.
